newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends up on foreign fund inflows.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends up on foreign fund inflows.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed higher against its U.S. counterpart on Wednesday amid inflows of foreign funds for the rebounding stock market, dealers said.
The local unit finished at T$27.632 against Tuesday's T$27.645 close, off an intraday high of T$27.619.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$202.5 million.
"As the stock market rebounded strongly in recent days, foreign funds vigilantly accelerated their entries," said one dealer.
On Wednesday, the Taiwan stock index ended up 146.32 points, or 1.74 percent at 8,576.94, the third straight day of gains.
Dealers also attributed the Taiwan dollar appreciation to the softness of the U.S. dollar in overseas markets.
For Thursday, a T$27.62-64 range was seen.
